parsed.answer: This is a known limitation. Task Manager, UAC/install prompts and other elevated or secure-desktop windows can only be controlled by Mouse Without Borders if it has elevated rights. The fix reported in the earlier tickets (PowerToys#26326) was to run PowerToys as administrator on BOTH computers; the maintainer also suggested installing the Mouse Without Borders service so it can interact with elevated apps. Your report shows PowerToys running non-elevated, so run it as admin on both machines (Settings > General > Run at startup / 'Always run as administrator') and enable the MWB service. Until then, the workaround is to use the physical keyboard/mouse of the computer showing the dialog, or close the elevated window to regain control. Note that in other reports (PowerToys#40579, PowerToys#41750) the same lockout was seen with Task Manager and UAC prompts and no other fix was given.
